notes.title: Ho-Ho-Ho, Merry Drumpfmess!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35038924/1e7242fe917c77dd40cfc428870ba5cac9e77bed.png[/img]

[i]Ho ho ho, seasons greetings friends![/i]  In case you haven't heard, our holly-jolly new dating sim, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197350/Santas_Big_Sack/]"Santa's Big Sack"[/url][/b]  launched on Steam this past Friday, just in time to stuff the world's stocking!

To commemorate this most merrily momentous occasion, we've released a small, limited-time seasonal update to [i]Drumpf: Presidential Dating Simulator[/i], as a special gift for all our incredible fans.

Please take a moment to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197350/Santas_Big_Sack/]size up Santa's Big Sack[/url][/b] if you haven't already,  and I hope you enjoy Drumpf's new Christmas content (which is contained within the opening two chapters of the game).  

[i]"Sexy Christmas to all, and to all a hot night!"[/i]
